sv.title: Richard och Sofia fick psykoser under adhd-medicineringen
sv.summary: Sofia och Richard drabbades av psykoser när de åt adhd-medicin. Trots att antalet diagnoser har ökat lavinartat har antalet rapporterade psykoser, en av medicinens ovanliga men kända biverkningar, legat stilla.

en.title: Richard and Sofia developed psychoses during ADHD medication
en.summary: Sofia and Richard suffered psychoses while taking ADHD medication. Although the number of diagnoses has increased explosively, the number of reported psychoses, one of the medication's rare but known side effects, has remained flat.
